parts.one_line: The open items of every plan in progress are shown from the plan files, with each plan's Direction and Waits on, and the one chosen becomes Now through a session.
Each plan's Waits on list is worked out from the needs of its parts in the product model, never set by hand.
A paused plan's branch lands on main and main's plan file says it has no branch; when its work starts again, a new branch is cut and named there.
